methods.name: MCP regression tools through call_tool_with_session: glmnet JSON
methods.reference: glmnet::glmnet, glmnet::cv.glmnet (the R cases of each method)
quantities: glmnet coefficient path (lasso, ridge, binomial) and default path lambdas/df; cv coefficients equal the library's; the selection summary precedes the path in the reply
methods.tolerance: glmnet coefficients 1e-3 absolute at MCP's thresh 1e-7 (an R port of p2a's coordinate descent lies at most 1.7e-4 from the exact minimiser on these fits), deviance ratios 1e-5 absolute, default path lambdas Tol::coef(150), df exact
